# How to Replace a Commercial Fridge Seal


When your commercial fridge door


isn’t


closing properly, or you notice


cold air


escaping, it might be time to replace the fridge seal. A damaged or worn-out seal can


impact


energy efficiency, increase running costs, and compromise food safety. Knowing how to replace a fridge seal is essential for


maintaining


reliable cooling performance and preventing unnecessary energy waste. In this guide,


we’ll


explain


how to replace a commercial fridge seal


, why


it’s


important, and how


Filta


can help you keep your equipment in top condition.


## **Why you need to replace your commercial fridge seal**


Understanding


how to replace a fridge door seal


is important because your fridge seal creates an airtight barrier that keeps cold air in and warm air out. Over time, seals can become cracked, warped, or loose due to heavy use or temperature fluctuations, all of which can affect your fridge’s efficiency and performance.


Failing to replace a damaged seal can cause:


- Temperature fluctuations and spoiled stock


- Higher energy bills due to the fridge working harder


- Hygiene and food safety risks from condensation and bacteria build-up


Regular inspections and timely replacement of commercial fridge seals can save money and extend the life of your equipment.


## **How to replace a fridge seal**


Replacing a fridge door seal may sound complicated, but with the right tools and a careful approach, it can be done efficiently. Here’s a step-by-step guide on


how to replace a fridge door seal.


#### ***Measure and source a new seal***


Before removing the old seal, it’s important to measure your fridge door accurately to ensure you get the correct


replacement fridge seal


. Use a tape measure to record the full perimeter of the door and note the fridge model and type.


When sourcing a new seal, check that it matches the profile, material, and size of your original seal, different fridges often require specific designs to maintain an airtight fit. Filta can take the hassle out of this process by identifying the correct seal for your fridge and providing a professional on-site make and fit service, so you don’t have to worry about ordering the wrong part or struggling with installation.


#### ***Remove the old door seal***


- Turn off the power to your fridge for safety.


- Gently pull the old seal away from the door. Some models have seals that clip in, while others may be secured with screws or adhesive.


- Take note of how the old seal is fitted, as this will help you install the new one correctly.


#### ***Clean between the door seal***


Before fitting the new


replacement fridge seal


, clean the area where the old seal was attached. Use warm, soapy water to remove any dirt, mould, or residue. Allow it to dry completely to ensure a secure fit for the new seal.


#### ***Fit the new seal***


- Align the new replacement fridge seal along the door frame.


- Press it into place or secure with screws if needed.


- Ensure all sides are flat and even for an airtight fit.


#### ***Check the installation***


- Close the door and check for gaps or uneven areas. You can test the seal by placing a piece of paper between the door and the frame, if you can pull it out easily, the seal isn’t tight enough.


## **Maintaining your fridge door seal**


- Once you’ve replaced the seal, regular maintenance will keep it working efficiently. Wipe it down weekly with warm water and mild detergent to prevent dirt build-up. Avoid harsh chemicals, as they can cause the seal to dry out or crack.


- You can also perform periodic checks to ensure the seal is still airtight. If you notice damage, don’t wait, replace the fridge seal promptly to prevent further issues.


## **Benefits of replacing your fridge door seal**


- Improved energy efficiency: Keeps cold air inside, reducing power consumption.
- Enhanced food safety: Keeps a consistent temperature to protect products and reduce waste.
- Cost savings: Reduces energy bills and prevents premature equipment failure.
- Compliance: Helps meet hygiene and safety standards required in commercial kitchens.


## **Equipment needed to replace a fridge seal**


Before starting, make sure you have:


- A


replacement fridge seal


suited to your model


- A screwdriver (if applicable)


- Warm water and mild detergent


- A clean cloth or sponge


If you’re wondering, “


Can you replace a fridge door seal


yourself?” or “


Can I replace the seal of my fridge door


without professional help?”, the answer is yes — especially if you’re confident with hands-on tasks. However, if you’re not comfortable with practical work, or for best results with commercial equipment, professional installation ensures accuracy and durability.
